name: Mémorial ACTe
funding: Public cultural body since 2019 joining the French state, Région Guadeloupe, the Département, Cap Excellence and Pointe-à-Pitre. The Région's then-president launched the €83M building.

name: Bienal de Arte Paiz
funding: 24th edition (2025-26) run by Fundación Paiz; founder money from the Paiz retail family.

name: Museo Ixchel del Traje Indígena
funding: Small private textile museum on the UFM campus; paid for by membership tiers (Q300 to Q10,000), the US charity Friends of the Ixchel Museum (since 1984) and project grants.

name: Museo Nacional de Arte Moderno Carlos Mérida (MUNAM)
funding: State museum of the Ministerio de Cultura y Deportes, which spent over Q16M (about US$2M) on roof and museography works in 2023-25.

name: Museo Popol Vuh
funding: Small university museum of Universidad Francisco Marroquín, supported by corporate room sponsorships; the last roster published is for 2019.

name: Musée National de Guinée (Sandervalia)
funding: State museum being rebuilt with a €16M concessional AFD (France) loan signed 30 Mar 2026; the Guinean state funds operations.

name: FOKAL
funding: Open Society Foundations paid a final package in 2024 as it closed its national foundations. Kellogg, Ford and Citi-CAF fund it; the diaspora fund Ayiti Demen raised $609,068.

name: Museo para la Identidad Nacional (MIN)
funding: Small foundation museum run by the Fundación Hondureña para la Identidad Nacional. Donors not published.

name: Asia Art Archive (AAA)
funding: Individuals, foundations, corporate patrons, HK government agencies and an annual auction; the US arm cites NYSCA, NYC DCLA and the Ruth Foundation.

name: CHAT (Centre for Heritage, Arts and Textile)
funding: Non-profit Mill6 Foundation, founded by Vanessa Cheung. Founding donor: D. H. Chen Foundation. Main donor: Nan Fung Group, the property group that owned the mills.

name: Para Site
funding: Yenn and Alan Lo Foundation, Sunpride Foundation and Cheng-Lan Foundation lead the 2025 gala list. Galleries such as Gagosian, Zwirner and White Cube give; annual benefit auction and Patrons' Circle.
